content.comment_body: Hello, I'm new to [product_name] and I have a specific module. Could someone explain how to program it and which cable is necessary to connect it to the [product_name] software? Also, do I need any additional [product_name] modules to use it? Thank you.

Hi, This is a rather old [product_name], so its features are limited. You can program it using the integrated keys or with [product_name] software, as described in the manual. There are two cable types you can use: RS232 and USB. Whether you need other modules depends on your required I/O. The [product_name] module you mentioned cannot be expanded, so you only need a power supply. Please check the compatibility overview of [product_name] modules. If programming with [product_name] software, make sure to select your module type (hardware selection: Ctrl+H), otherwise your program might not fit. Regards,
